publisher: MassGIS (Massachusetts Executive Office of Technology and Security Services)
notes: MassGIS statewide Property Tax Parcels, about 2.2M features, EPSG:26986. Owner, site address, assessed value and land use are not on this layer; they sit in the separate assessors database extract table, which this service does not expose. MAP_PAR_ID is blank for some parcels; LOC_ID is always populated.
